answer_1.quote: We define the system objective as the healthcare task for which a system is designed... assist users by providing information or guidance (e.g., by answering questions from users who are filling out forms).
answer_1.outputs: dialogue responses in task-oriented healthcare settings

answer_2.quote: In contrast, automated evaluation provides an objective, quantitative measurement of one or more dimensions of the system from a mathematical perspective.

answer_4.quote: We defined human evaluation, often implemented in prior work through questionnaires or direct feedback from realworld users, as an evaluation that relies on subjective, first-hand, human user experience.
answer_4.guideline: questionnaires or direct feedback from realworld users
